items.evidence: Valid apiLevel 2.15; 1 uL by p20 and 50 uL by p300 are within range; 61 uL max in a 200 uL well; the thermocycler and labware are used as intended.
Each plasmid and each SOC dispense gets its own pick_up_tip/drop_tip; the tip checks (tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end, no_cross_contamination) all passed.

The agent added steps the paper does not specify: p20.mix(3,5) in the cells after DNA addition and p300.mix(3,40) after SOC. It also deactivated the lid during the 4 C and 42 C steps and heated it to 50 C only for recovery.
The block is set to 4 C before pipetting, then p20 moves 1 uL from plasmid well n to transformation well n for all 8 wells, with a fresh tip each time.
tc.close_lid(), then set_block_temperature(4, hold_time_minutes=30), then set_block_temperature(42, hold_time_seconds=30), then back to 4 C, all on the thermocycler.
p300 adds 50 uL SOC to each of the 8 wells after heat shock, then set_block_temperature(37, hold_time_minutes=60) with the lid closed.

judge.summary: The protocol follows the core timeline correctly: 1 uL DNA into 10 uL cells, 4 C for 30 min, 42 C for 30 s, 50 uL SOC, then 37 C for 1 h. It fails fidelity because it adds mixing steps the paper does not describe and handles the lid temperature in its own way.
